WITH city_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    city_id,
    COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses,
    SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses
  FROM city_stats
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.city_id,
    cs.address_count,
    cs.address_count / t.avg_addresses AS count_div_avg,
    cs.address_count / t.total_addresses AS share,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.address_count / t.total_addresses DESC) AS rank_by_share
  FROM city_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  city_id,
  address_count,
  count_div_avg,
  share
FROM with_metrics
WHERE rank_by_share <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC, city_id
